title.description: The post's title. At most 200 characters.

slug.description: The post's link name: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, like "autumn-candles". Left out on a new post = made from the title.

summary.description: One or two sentences, at most 300 characters. Shown on the list and used as the description for search engines and shared links.

body.description: The post's text as HTML: p, h2, h3, ul, ol, li, a, strong, em, blockquote, figure, figcaption, img, table. Scripts and styles are removed. A picture is a /uploads/… path of this shop, an https link, or the picture itself as a data:image/…;base64, URI in the src. Base64 pictures are saved to the shop's storage (at most 20, 5 MB each, 8 MB for the whole call).

tags.description: Topics, like ["Coffee", "Guides"]. At most 10, each at most 30 characters.

status.description: draft = only staff see it. published = it shows on the online store from published_at on.

published_at.description: When the post goes live, as an ISO date and time (2026-10-20T09:00:00Z). A later time schedules it. Left out on a published post = now.

cover.description: The thumbnail: a /uploads/<shop id>/… path of this shop, an https:// link to a picture, or the picture itself as base64 (a data:image/…;base64, URI or plain base64, 5 MB at most). A link or base64 is saved to the shop's storage. null = none.
